Comparing them, it can be known that the land parcel with the highest increase in land price is Yi.

method.method_draft: Overlay the parcel layer with the price layer and the metro-station layer. For each named parcel, note whether it is at/near a station and its original value. 乙 is at a station and its original price is 10, so its possible rise is about 50−10=40. 甲 is also at a station but already has price 50, so it cannot rise much. 丙 and 丁 are not as directly matched with station locations, and their potential rises are smaller or not triggered. Therefore the highest land-price increase is for 乙.
